instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph captures three women against a plain white background. On the left, the smiling woman in the purple shirt (R2) stands in profile, looking left. Hugging her closely from behind is the laughing woman in the green blazer (R3), who has her arms wrapped around the purple-shirted woman's chest with hands clasped. Mostly obscured in the background on the right, the woman in the blue blazer (R1) is partially visible behind the others. Soft, bright studio lighting evenly illuminates the scene, highlighting the vibrant pastel palette of their clothing and creating a cheerful, warm atmosphere.
